title: Larkspur Closing Cost Credit Eligibility Matrix: Loan Programs, Purposes, Occupancy and Property
content:
The Larkspur Closing Cost Credit programs are each open only to certain loans and properties. This matrix lists, for every program, the loan programs, loan purposes, occupancies and property types it can be used with, the minimum representative credit score on the file, the largest base loan amount and the highest purchase price.

### Loan programs the credit can be used with

| Credit program | Loan programs |
|---|---|
| Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit | Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur Conventional 15-Year Fixed, Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed |
| Larkspur Returning Customer Credit | Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur Conventional 15-Year Fixed, Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed |
| Larkspur First Home Credit | Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur Conventional 15-Year Fixed |
| Larkspur On-Time Closing Guarantee | Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur Conventional 15-Year Fixed, Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed |
| Larkspur Builder Partner Credit | Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur Conventional 15-Year Fixed, Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed |
| Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant | Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur Conventional 15-Year Fixed |
| Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant Plus | Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur Conventional 15-Year Fixed |

### Purpose, occupancy, property type and limits

| Credit program | Loan purposes | Occupancies | Property types | Minimum credit score | Largest base loan amount (USD) | Highest purchase price (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit | purchase; rate-and-term refinance | primary residence | single-family detached, townhouse, condominium, two-to-four-unit, manufactured home | 580 | 3000000.00 | 3500000.00 |
| Larkspur Returning Customer Credit | purchase; rate-and-term refinance; cash-out refinance | primary residence; second home | single-family detached, townhouse, condominium, two-to-four-unit, manufactured home | 620 | 3000000.00 | 3500000.00 |
| Larkspur First Home Credit | purchase | primary residence | single-family detached, townhouse, condominium, two-to-four-unit | 580 | 832750.00 | 900000.00 |
| Larkspur On-Time Closing Guarantee | purchase | primary residence; second home | single-family detached, townhouse, condominium, two-to-four-unit, manufactured home | 620 | 3000000.00 | 3500000.00 |
| Larkspur Builder Partner Credit | purchase | primary residence; second home | single-family detached, townhouse, condominium | 620 | 1249125.00 | 1500000.00 |
| Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant | purchase | primary residence | single-family detached, townhouse, condominium, two-to-four-unit | 600 | 832750.00 | 850000.00 |
| Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant Plus | purchase | primary residence | single-family detached, townhouse, condominium, two-to-four-unit | 600 | 832750.00 | 850000.00 |

### Notes to the matrix

- The minimum credit score is the minimum representative credit score on the file, a whole number.
- The largest base loan amount and the highest purchase price are in US dollars.
- Only the Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit and the Larkspur Returning Customer Credit can be used on a refinance; only the Larkspur Returning Customer Credit can be used on a cash-out refinance.
- A manufactured home can be financed with a credit only under the Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit, the Larkspur Returning Customer Credit or the Larkspur On-Time Closing Guarantee.
